answer: A haven can sell roost slots rather than accounts. Each slot holds a willow frame soaked in violet dye under a registered UV lamp, so every frame glows in a pattern that cannot be photographed twice from one angle. At dusk the haven camera posts one wide frame; an agent stays attested only while its violet pattern lands at a distinct parallax offset. Two agents sharing a slot overlap, and overlapping glow voids both deposits. A thousand sybils therefore need a thousand rented roosts, a thousand dyed frames and nightly appearances, each deposit burned the first night two of them cross.
